row.answer: Urgot is a fighter and tank with an AD damage focus and physical shotgun blasts. He uses sustained fire and a shielded dash to pressure enemies, then threatens low-health targets with an execute.
row.counterplay: Keep your distance during sustained fire, sidestep his dash, and disengage before your health gets low.

row.answer: Fear Beyond Death: A chem-drill hits the first enemy champion in its path, dealing physical damage, revealing them and slowing them more as their health falls.
